_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::tsi#6. Upstream tsi_lincompression_1waydisp with four TYPE tokens on its SOLIDSCATRA lines. The claim is falsified twice. 'TYPE Std' does NOT throw: it runs to 'processor 0 finished normally' with all 5 result tests CORRECT, exactly like 'TYPE Undefined' (STD_THROWS=0, STD_RESULT_TESTS_CORRECT=5 = UNDEFINED_RESULT_TESTS_CORRECT). And omitting TYPE is not a runtime FOUR_C_THROW at problem setup but a parse error while reading the element line, "Required value 'TYPE' not found in input line" from 4C_io_input_spec_builders.cpp, carrying none of the SOLIDSCATRA wording (OMITTED_THROWS_SOLIDSCATRA_MESSAGE=0). What does throw is a value outside the enum: 'The input type Bogus is not valid for SOLIDSCATRA elements!' from 4C_solid_scatra_3D_ele_lib.cpp — and still during element reading, before any mesh or time step exists (BOGUS_REACHED_FILL_COMPLETE=0, BOGUS_REACHED_FIRST_TIME_STEP=0), not 'at the first time step'. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Required value 'TYPE' not found in input line
The input type Bogus is not valid for SOLIDSCATRA elements!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the out-of-enum arm a legal TYPE. Nothing then throws, the 'not valid for SOLIDSCATRA elements' line disappears and EXIT_TYPE_BOGUS becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's/KINEM linear TYPE Undefined/KINEM linear TYPE Bogus/' "$BASE"
_mutation.to: sed 's/KINEM linear TYPE Undefined/KINEM linear TYPE Loma/'  "$BASE"
